WITH RECURSIVE model_bom AS (
    SELECT parent_code, child_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'model'
      AND child_kind = 'component'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT mb.parent_code, c.child_code
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'component'
     AND c.parent_code = mb.child_code
     AND c.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT parent_code) AS model_count
FROM model_bom
WHERE child_code = 'MOT-925-BLK-02620';
```

MATCH (m:Model)-[u:USES]->(c:Component)-[e:HAS_PART*0..6 (r, n | WHERE r.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2026-10-01') <= r.valid_to))]->(t:Component {component_code: 'MOT-925-BLK-02620'})
WHERE u.valid_from <= date('2026-10-01') AND (u.valid_to IS NULL OR date('2026-10-01') <= u.valid_to)
RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS models

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(component_id) AS (
  SELECT component_id
  FROM component
  WHERE component_code = 'MOT-925-BLK-02620'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.parent_component_id
  FROM ancestors a
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.child_component_id = a.component_id
  WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
    AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.model_id) AS model_count
FROM ancestors a
JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.component_id = a.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to);
```

WITH RECURSIVE sold_models AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        ol.line_no,
        s.sku_code AS current_code,
        'sku' AS current_kind,
        ol.qty AS qty,
        o.order_date AS d
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku s ON l.sku_id = s.sku_id
    JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.store_id
    WHERE st.country = 'UK'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' 
      AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        sm.order_id,
        sm.line_no,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        sm.qty * uc.qty AS qty,
        sm.d
    FROM sold_models sm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = sm.current_kind 
                          AND uc.parent_code = sm.current_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= sm.d 
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.d <= uc.valid_to)
)
SELECT current_code AS model_code
FROM sold_models
WHERE current_kind = 'model'
GROUP BY current_code
ORDER BY SUM(qty) DESC, current_code
LIMIT 3;
```

WITH RECURSIVE order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.qty, l.sku_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024
),
expanded_skus(sku_id, qty) AS (
    SELECT ol.sku_id, ol.qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id, es.qty * bi.qty
    FROM expanded_skus es
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = es.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = es.sku_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle = true
)
SELECT cm.model_code
FROM expanded_skus es
JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = es.sku_id
JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = es.sku_id
JOIN company_model cm ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id
WHERE sk.is_bundle = false
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(es.qty * sm.qty) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```cypher
MATCH (o:SalesOrder)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(l:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU),
      (l)-[:LISTED_IN]->(s:Store),
      (o)-[:PLACED_IN]->(s),
      (sku)-[e:CONTAINS*1..6]->(m:Model)
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND s.country = 'UK' AND date_part('year', o.order_date) = 2024
WITH m.model_code AS model_code, sum(hl.qty * list_product(properties(rels(e), 'qty'))) AS total_units
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN model_code
